term: Hume first causal definition: similarity and succession
definition: RegularCause(a,b) requires a to be followed by b and every object similar to a to be followed by an object similar to b. Similarity and succession remain explicit interpretation parameters; this is the first VII.29 definition, not an identity with intervention efficacy or a complete ontology of production.
note: Explicit analytical interface for issue #270. Source support and its limits are separately recorded in the linked source claims and docs/hume-regularity.md. Stronger metaphysical identifications require further argument.
